resources.string: Your Voxara watch can include headphone listening from this phone in its weekly hearing budget. This is optional and off until you turn it on.
What is sent to your watch, about every 15 minutes while you listen: the time, how long, the media volume, and the type of output (wired, Bluetooth…). The watch turns this into an estimated level.
Never sent or stored: audio, song or video titles, app names, headphone names or Bluetooth addresses. Nothing goes to the internet; it travels only to your own watch.

Limits: sampling every 15 minutes cannot see pauses or volume changes in between, so these numbers are rough estimates. Wired headphones are only seen when a sample happens to run. Not a medical device.
